reference: raft-ui@0.5.27/fonts.css Elegant heading-font=Inter; Web uses Google Fonts CSS

records.derivation: tool/parity-fonts/derive_inter.py: opsz axis pinned at its default 14, wght axis kept (fontTools 4.66.1 varLib.instancer). This is the axis set Google Fonts serves to the Web for raft-ui's `Inter:wght@400;500;600;700` request; outlines/advances verified identical to every Google-served Inter v20 woff2 subset (1690 codepoints) at wght 300/400/500/600/700. Without this, Flutter applied opsz up to 32 to elegant headings while Web always renders opsz 14.
